lead: Manoj Kumar was a film actor, born on 1937 in Abbottabad.
He died on 4 April 2025 in Mumbai at the age of 87.
He has 49 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
This profile collects the Manoj facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
